case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so openly. We value the reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair renewal for both sides.

Looking at the same indices and our own purchasing data, we see a somewhat different picture:

German producer prices for bearings and gears changed +0.8% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2815@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08).

We also buy Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 from another source, at EUR 4.06 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011504-10) and EUR 4.20 on 2026-09-22 (po:4500014447-10).

With that in mind, we have prepared three genuine options. Each offers a longer contract term than your proposal, giving you more planning security, and Option C keeps your preferred payment terms.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.51; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.38; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.48; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We look forward to hearing which option works best for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. However, the price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company, and that does not change our position. Please note that the purchase orders you referenced from another source cannot be directly compared to our products and service. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract term, which provides planning security for both sides. Our current offer is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can offer a revised price of €4.88 per unit for a 24-month contract with 30 days payment terms, which is a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note this offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

claims.sentence: Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the move to a longer term. We appreciate the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a renewal that is fair to both.

We have noted your view on the index data and will not repeat it. One point from our own records does matter for value, though:
Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

With that in mind, we have prepared three options. All keep the longer contract term you welcomed for planning security:
We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.56; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.53; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hope one of them works for you and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your latest options and the delivery data you provided. As to the delivery record data you cited, that does not change our position. As our overall scorecard standing with you remains green, this data does not warrant a price reduction.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Beside this option, we can offer a new option of EUR 4.90 per unit for a 24-month contract with 45 days payment terms. Another alternative is a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.
